title: React
tagline: Build modern, accessible, high-performance user interfaces with React 19, hooks, routing, and clean state architecture.
description: Go from JSX fundamentals and immutable state updates to custom hooks, race-free effects, Context/reducers, React Router, concurrent transitions, and rendering optimization.
whatYoullLearn: Think declaratively in components, unidirectional data flow, and immutable state updates
Master useState, useEffect, useRef, useReducer, useContext, and reusable custom hooks
Eliminate redundant effects, stale closures, and race conditions in async data fetching
Optimize rendering with memoization, code splitting, Error Boundaries, and React 19 transitions

levelSummaries.Beginner: JSX & components, props & composition, useState & events, conditional rendering, lists & keys.
levelSummaries.Intermediate: useEffect & cleanup, refs, controlled forms, custom hooks, routing, Context & useReducer.
levelSummaries.Advanced: Reconciliation & memoization, concurrent UI (useTransition/useDeferredValue), React 19 Actions, RSC & security.

projectTitle: Interactive Kanban & Study Sprint Board in React 19
